title: CrisisGuardUnifiedMediaRiskRecord
description: Standardized schema contract for synthetic media risk predictions across video and image forensics branches in CrisisGuard.

content_id.description: Canonical identifier for the evaluated media asset.

media_type.description: Media modality of the input asset.

model_branch.description: Forensics branch responsible for the prediction.

model_version.description: Semantic version identifier of the inference model.

model_score.description: The raw continuous model output score or logit before or after sigmoid transformation.

synthetic_probability.description: A probability-like bounded model output in [0.0, 1.0]. Represents a calibrated probability ONLY when calibration_status is CALIBRATED_PLATT or CALIBRATED_EMPIRICAL; otherwise represents an uncalibrated model score.

synthetic_risk.description: A bounded downstream feature in [0.0, 1.0] representing model-estimated synthetic-media risk for pipeline ranking, without implying absolute ground truth or malicious intent.

calibration_status.description: Statistical calibration validity of the probability score. Separated strictly from media quality.

prediction_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of inference execution.

source_dataset.description: Origin benchmark or stream source (e.g. CIFAKE, Google_DFD_Controlled_Sample).

quality_status.description: Physical signal and format integrity of the input media asset. Strictly independent from model calibration.

provenance.description: Auditable data provenance lineage and author validation tag.
